[2.22.3] Fix: Update download button — replaced broken modal window with native dialog

fullchange: [2.22.3] Fix: Duplicate bill number — save_exit now calls allocate() to verify the reserved number matches the actual billNo before consuming. Mismatch triggers release() instead of silently leaking the reservation. Edit-bill and edit-order modes excluded from this check.

[2.22.3] Fix: Update download button — replaced separate BrowserWindow modal (had frame, script loading, and IPC timing issues) with native dialog.showMessageBox. In-page modal code kept for future use.

[2.22.3] Fix: appLogger hash chain integrity — lastLineHash only advances when todaysLog.write() succeeds. On backpressure, subsequent entries are queued and drained sequentially via 'drain' event, preserving strict hash chain ordering.
